gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-taviraj: Chunky tubing letters up top, bookish type below. Aaargh is at its best commanding attention with uniform strokes, while Taviraj does its finest work with moderate stroke contrast and generous gaps where each curve ends.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-uchen: Round, commanding letters with walls that never swell. Aaargh lays down its uniform bowls like pipework, and Uchen follows with dignified, gently contrasted strokes that keep the page from feeling mechanical.
